headline: Astra Duel: Mythic Rāmāyaṇa Combat in Pure HTML
text:
Counter divine astras, chant Sanskrit verses to build tejas, and face Rāvaṇa's 10 heads.

An epic Rāmāyaṇa duel built in a single zero-dependency HTML file. Zero install, loads in 0.1s:
https://kreeda.games/dasanana/index.html

#gamedev #indiedev
mediaSuggestion: A fast-paced 8-second gameplay GIF showing a fire vs. water astra clash, Sanskrit rhythm chanting triggering a golden glow, and the Brahmāstra firing against Rāvaṇa.
